document.title: [Excised] Talking Points: CIA Operations Against Usama Bin Ladin
document.publisher: National Security Archive (GWU), The Central Intelligence Agency 9/11 File: Hundreds of Secret Agency Documents on Osama Bin Laden Declassified
document.note: CIA talking points on CIA operations against bin Laden. Cited in 9/11 Commission Report Chapter 4, Endnote 157.

persons.name: Usama Bin Ladin
persons.role: Target of CIA capture and disruption operations; leader of an international terrorist infrastructure
persons.status_detail: Alive at the time of the document (February 1999); the CIA sought to capture him and bring him to justice

mentions.quote: Agency's operations against Osama Bin Ladin (UBL)
The Agency's current slate of operations against Usama Bin Ladin (UBL)
Our disruption operations now are aimed at capturing Bin Ladin

persons.name: Congressman Hastert
persons.role: US Congressman to be briefed on CIA operations against UBL

mentions.quote: Purpose: To inform Congressman Hastert about CIA's operations against Osama Bin Ladin (UBL)

organizations.name: Central Intelligence Agency
organizations.notes: Author of the talking points. Runs operations to capture Bin Ladin, collect intelligence on his location, and disrupt his international infrastructure.

organizations.name: Intelligence Community
organizations.notes: Described as devoting all applicable resources to collecting against Bin Ladin.

organizations.name: US military
organizations.notes: Conducted the August 1998 missile strikes; the text refers to military options targeting Bin Ladin.

organizations.name: al-Qa'ida
organizations.notes: Inferred from context. The document names only UBL and his 'international infrastructure'.

events.description: US missile strikes, referred to in the talking points as '20 August 1998 US missile strikes'. The target text is largely excised, but the strikes were related to Bin Ladin.

key_claims: As of February 1999, CIA operations against UBL aimed at capture and rendering him to justice.
The CIA operations were divided into categories, including seeking his location through collection and disruption operations.
Disruption operations aimed at capturing UBL, dismantling his international infrastructure and gathering actionable intelligence.
The Intelligence Community was devoting all applicable resources to collecting against UBL.
The document references military options and the 20 August 1998 US missile strikes against UBL-related targets.
